newsitem.title: USA: Ashland endorses Ashland Coal merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Ashland endorses Ashland Coal merger talks.

text.p: Ashland Inc endorses the resumption of merger talks between the company's coal mining affiliates, chief executive Paul W. Chellgren told Reuters.
Earlier this month the two companies -- Ashland Coal Inc and Arch Mineral Corp -- said the planned to resume talks on possible options for combining the two coal companies.
Ashland Coal is 56 percent owned by Ashland Inc, which owns 50 percent of Arch. The other 50 percent is held by desendants of H.L. Hunt, Chellgren noted.
Noting both companies have formed special board committee's to handle the negotiations, he said Ashland is "now on the outside looking in."
He also said "We strongly endorse the concept of the two companies coming together."
